messages:
Priya: Quick PM handoff (18:00-02:00). Few items to watch:
- prefetched-cache TTL lowered to 45s for embed paths (was 120s) — should reduce stale responses but watch cache miss rate.
- canary deploy of redwood-large-v2 happened at 17:42; deploy-bot: canary OK, but we saw a 3–5min latency bump in us-west (~2x p50).
- background vacuum scheduled at 23:30 UTC on primary DB (low risk but connection saturation possible for short windows).
- There's a small spike in 4xx from one client (client-id: acme-pay). I've opened a ticket in #support-admin and flagged for follow-up.
Action items: Lina covers 20:00-00:00; Jared can you review PR #432 (batching policy tweak) before midnight? @Jared

Jared: Ack. I'll take a look — prioritizing PR#432 now. If you still see p50 > 400ms after 19:00 I'll flip the routing to fallback-model.

Lina: Taking 20:00-00:00. I'll keep an eye on queue depth and KV cache hit-rate. If queue > 500 or avg token latency > 600ms I'll open a bridge and fail to redwood-medium-1.

Priya: For the routing flip: run the short command below if needed — it should preserve session affinity.
```
infra route set --group inference/us-west --fallback-model redwood-medium-1 --reason "handoff latency"
```
Also note: the Dedicated pool has 12% headroom right now; if we see sustained > 70% utilization, we might need to enable burst-capacity (ops-bot can do this automatically if you toggle).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed at 17:42. Monitors OK. No errors in tail logs. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Observability alerting: KV cache hit-rate down 12% since 17:30. Threshold at 10% triggers paging. Current: 88%.

Lina: On the DB vacuum — I'll watch for connection retries around 23:30 and will mute non-actionable alerts for 5m.

Jared: PR review done. Minor nits, merged. :thumbsup: Also leaving a small script in /tools/replay to reproduce the acme-pay 4xx pattern.

Priya: Thanks all. If anything urgent ping here or call. I'll be reachable until 18:30 for questions, then switching to offline. Leaving the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall_handoff

Lina: Got it, monitoring. Good luck! :rocket:

Jared: Good handoff. I'll jump on if any latency regressions.
